name: spinal stretch (on stability ball)
description: A gentle back stretch draped over or kneeling at a stability ball. It lengthens the spine and relaxes the torso.
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms or hands on top.
Roll the ball forward as you sink your hips back.
Let your head drop between your arms and lengthen your spine.
Roll the ball back in to come up.
